edge_explainer: RE-COURT of the 08-05 exit-band referral. The referral was right that no number above $140 existed in the record, and right to refuse to invent one -- but the ceiling was STALE, not breached. CAUSE (the referral top gap, now closed): the unexplained 08-05 tape was the fiscal Q3 FY26 print, released after the close 2026-08-04 (8-K 0001628280-26-052563 + 10-Q 0001628280-26-052573). The reaction is itself the finding -- 08-05 opened +1.6%, spiked to $151.98 (+6.5%), and closed $144.67 (+1.4%) on ~3x volume: a FAILED BREAKOUT / distribution day. MODE B LEAD (the decisive finding, hidden by the record framing): THE RECORD COURTS THE WRONG AXIS. Its whole signalos_role is a federal-cyclicality trap-debunk and its $130-140 came off a GOVERNMENT-INSULATION story. The Q3 release says growth is led by Data Center, Semiconductor, Energy & Power; the CFO says verbatim "as spending on the AI build-out has ramped up"; ENR ranks J #1 in Data Centers, up 6 categories y/y. J is now an AI/advanced-facilities capex services company that also does government work -- the $130->$145 re-rate is being paid for AI adjacency, on an axis the record does not price at all. MECHANISM: masking channel = PASS-THROUGH REVENUE INFLATION -- I&AF pass-through DOUBLED ($800.5M -> $1,659.8M, +107%) to 44.3% of I&AF gross from 29.7%, so headline gross growth of 34.5% is ~4x the economic 8.3%; same mechanic in bookings (gross b2b 1.5x vs adj-NR 1.1x); and it consumes capital (receivables +25.8% vs adj-NR +8.4%). HONESTY GRADE = CLEAN, and that is a POSITIVE anti-masking finding, not a null: the company prints both numbers in its own headline ("34% and 8%", "1.4x (1.2x Adj. NR)") with a full pass-through reconciliation. The masking channel is AVAILABLE and NOT USED -> no honesty-exclusion short here. The guide "raise" measured: the third-consecutive-raise headline is +$0.025 (+0.35%) on the FY26 adj EPS midpoint with the EBITDA-margin midpoint UNCHANGED -- a range NARROWING with one quarter left. Consistent (prior ranges printed inline) but narrative amplitude far exceeds numeric amplitude, and the ~11% move off the record $130.50 read is ENTIRELY MULTIPLE, not earnings. AND the FY26 guide is not sandbagged: 9M adj NR grew 8.44% against a 9.5-10.0% FY guide, so Q4 must ACCELERATE to ~+13.5% (arithmetic-certain direction); 9M adj EPS $5.12 leaves Q4 implied at $2.08-2.18 vs Q3 $1.84. CEILING RE-DERIVED on current numbers, cap structure pulled FIRST (117,132,889 common; preferred authorized 1,000,000 but NONE issued; no warrants/converts; redeemable NCI $1,018.7M -> $0, retired by the PA buy-in -- a genuine cap-structure improvement the record misses). Net debt $2,406.5M (LT debt $2,236.5M -> $3,579.4M for the PA buy-in, less $1,172.9M cash); ~118.5M diluted shares; at $144.67 mkt cap $17.14B / EV $19.55B = 19.95x FY26 adj EPS $7.25, 13.8x FY26 adj EBITDA ~$1,412M, ~17.8x FY27 adj EPS ~$8.15 (bottom-up; consensus-implied ~$8.23 corroborates). THE RECORD COMPS ARE STALE AND NOW INVERTED: it cited AECOM ~20x / TTEK ~28x as evidence J was fairly valued; live 08-05 ACM ~11x, TTEK ~19.7x, KBR ~8.9x -- the E&C set DE-RATED 30-45% while J re-rated up, so J now sits at the TOP of that set, the exact inverse of the record conclusion. But the comp set IS the question: as E&C, fair is 14-17x FY27 = $114-139; as AI-infra services (STRL ~21x, AGX ~37x), fair is 21-25x = $171-204. At 17.8x the market prices a ~60/40 blend toward E&C. E[FV] $143.06 vs spot $144.67 -> edge -1.1%: SPOT IS AT FAIR VALUE, NOT THROUGH IT. The $130-140 is re-struck to $135-150 base / $174 stretch. PATH: +36.9% off a 52w low ($105.68, 2026-05-13) that is only 57 sessions old -- the contract late-bounce rule fires. Archetype is neither de-rate nor derailment but a COMPLETED ROUND-TRIP (-37% then 62% retraced); bought 2026-05-26 @ $114.50, eight sessions after the low. Winner-management court, not an entry court.
